{{Short description|German mathematician}}
'''Wilhelm Frahm''' (14 May 1849 – 17 August 1875) was a German [[mathematician]] who worked on [[algebraic geometry]].<ref>{{cite book |last1=Tobies |first1=Renate |title=Felix Klein: Visionen für Mathematik, Anwendungen und Unterricht |date=7 March 2019 |publisher=Springer-Verlag |isbn=978-3-662-58749-2 |page=559 |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=XkaMDwAAQBAJ&dq=Algebra.+Mathematiker.+Wilhelm+Frahm&pg=PA559 |access-date=22 February 2024 |language=de}}</ref> He was born in [[Rendsburg]], [[Schleswig-Holstein]], and studied mathematics in [[Tübingen]].<ref>{{cite book |last1=Denecke |first1=Ludwig |title=Die Nachlässe in den Bibliotheken der Bundesrepublik Deutschland |date=1969 |publisher=H. Boldt |page=49 |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=5L67AAAAIAAJ&q=Algebra.+Mathematiker.+Wilhelm+Frahm+1875 |access-date=22 February 2024 |language=de}}</ref> He died in Munich of [[typhus]].
